name: pmg-synthesise-interviews
description: Synthesises real interview notes or transcripts into an affinity board, with need statements that cite their sources, contradictions between participants and the open questions to take back to customers. Use for "run pmg-synthesise-interviews", "synthesise these interviews", "affinity map my notes", "what did customers tell us", "turn transcripts into insights", "interview themes", "customer needs from interviews", "five transcripts and a PRD due", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
